entries.answer: Aye — dig out three words ye fancy an' cast `/wand`. A wand chooses ye for good. Same three words unlock `/patronus` an' `/broom` after. Animagus is separate — its own three words via `/animagus`.
Yer `/patronus` is cast from the same three words ye gave `/wand`. No wand yet? Start there first, then come back for the glow.

`/animagus` finds yer form from three words o' yer own (not the wand ones). Ye don't pick the animal — it picks ye. Locked for good. Cast `/animagus` again anytime to transform for a minute — every message ends with that animal's sound (e.g. *woof*).

Yer `/broom` comes from the same three words as yer wand — 100 fixed portraits, one owner each. If that broom's taken, ye get the next-closest. Base Speed an' Altitude are fixed per model (same on the Compendium); ye can upgrade 'em toward 10 with `/broomupgrade`. Need a wand first. Staff free a claim with `/staff identity broomreset` (wand stays). Full gallery's on the Compendium Brooms page.

Tune flight with `/broomupgrade` — Speed or Altitude / control, toward 10. Pay with Pitch Resin ×5 (forage in the Garden or Forbidden Woods; never on market), any Descent material ×100, or one Marketplace broom token (`/market broomtoken`, 50 pts). Optional `member:` upgrades someone else's broom while ye pay. Staff free bumps: `/staff identity upgradebroom`.

`/broomrace` on the Quidditch pitch — private 6-stage picks on one o' 100 courses. Every stage shows the full set o' lines — no spoon-feedin'. Ye gotta read; Speed/Altitude only help ye hold a clean line. Wrong picks add time; traps double it. Solo: 5 learning races a day (UTC) that unlock study notes. Challenge someone with `/broomrace opponent:@member` on the same track anytime — lowest time lost wins; winner gets 3 house points up to 5 wins/day, then free play with no points. Stuck mid-race or "already mid-race"? `/broomraceend` clears the lock — yours or anyone else's. Check leftovers on `/checklist`.
Finish a course with `/broomrace` an' ye unlock a permanent study note — read 'em with `/broomnotes`. Studied courses mark traps ye know with ⚠ when ye race that track again.

`/checklist` is yer daily points board — what's left for house points an' habits, with reset timers. Includes duels, Quidditch house-match wins, broom solo learning races (5/day), broom challenge point-wins (5/day at 3 pts), beasts, potions (brewable / ready to drink), market sells, an' more.
Design yer look with `/wizard` — there's Masculine, Feminine, an' Feminine (full body). Show it off anytime with `/mirror`.

`/familiar adopt` picks salamander, raven, or fox for good. Care lives under the same group: `/familiar feed`, `/familiar pet`, `/familiar play` (once a day each), an' `/familiar scout` for a lil' find. Check in with `/familiar status`; rename with `/familiar name`.

Each place has its own channel. Use `/explore` (up to 10/day per place) an' `/forage` (up to 5/day). Check `/satchel`, try `/use`, leave an `/offer`. `/places` shows where ye can go — places remember how ye treat 'em.

Beasts wander into the explore channel an' say what they want. First to `/approach` with those things befriends 'em. See yer collection with `/bestiary`, show one off with `/summon`. Want notes on one ye already have? That's `/study`.
Got a befriended beast? `/study` it once a day — three pages fills yer notes. Read 'em with `/journal`. Finish all three an' yer house gets **5** points once for that beast.
Nifflers are the shiny-thievin' beasts — one uncommon per place. Spot 'em in `/bestiary`, or brew **Niffler's Bait** if ye want a private encounter with one.

`/duel` is first to 2 (best of three) by default — that banks **1 win**. Pick **best of 5, 7, 9, or 51** an' ye play sets of first-to-2 until someone hits 3 / 4 / 5 / 26 — the series winner banks that many wins without startin' over. On **Duel Night** those banked wins all count on the night board at double points. Press **Open my cast board** an' yer spell buttons sit under that private board (same idea as broom races). Hex, Ward, Disarm, Bind, Mirror; each beats two an' loses to two. There's also `/trio scramble`, `/trio housematch`, an' `/grand` for the big leagues. Stuck on "already in a duel"? Cast `/duelend` to clear the lock.
When a wild threat crawls into a channel, `/cast` then tap the right spell button (Patronus for Dementors). If ye stirred it up explorin', ye get 25 seconds alone first.

The Descent is a hundred-floor solo dungeon — only in Descent channels. `/descend` fights yer next monster; add `auto:True` to chain the next fight after each win. `/descend floor:n` replays a cleared floor for practice an' loot. Idle 3 minutes with no button counts as a loss; `/descendend` forfeits the same way so ye can start fresh. `/descentstatus` shows floor, stats, an' lockouts. Three losses on a floor locks ye out 24 hours. Every win binds that monster into yer army for castle sieges.

Replay a cleared floor with `/descend floor:n` (not bosses). Practice can sharpen ye with a free stat pick — closer floors more often. Spend any pending stat pick first, or the grind won't award another. Practice wins still bind monsters into yer army.

Castle PvP lives in the castles channel. Descent wins bind monsters into yer army — `/army` shows the roster (castles + Descent channels) an' lets ye sacrifice 500 regulars for ATK or DEF. `/castles` opens the map: reinforce anytime (not mid-assault), siege on Wed & Sat (Chicago), or abandon. One castle per player. Before PvP goes live, binds are uncapped; once live it's 200/day an' 5,000 total. Each keep has a perk (duel ties, Descent half-attack, `/cast` auto-pick, an' more) — full list on the Compendium Castles page.
Quidditch runs house matches an' scrambles — five rounds, an' a Snitch that can end it all. Peek `/help` or the Compendium Quidditch page for the commands.
`/raid` opens a 3Raid lobby — Attacker, Specialty, Tank, ten encounters. `/raidstatus` shows yer weekly clear.

`/market browse` is the catalogue. Buy common/uncommon with `/market buy`. Sell place ingredients in sets of 3, or Descent materials in sets of 25, for 3 pts each batch — add `batches:` to sell several at once (21 pts/day cap). `/market broomtoken` buys a Speed or Altitude broom upgrade token (50 pts) — spend it with `/broomupgrade`. Also scrolls, titles, an' the Room. Pitch Resin is forage-only — never sold.

`/potions` is yer recipe book — Rep rank, satchel o' brewed draughts, an' every recipe with 🟢/🔴 ingredient dots. Brew with `/brew`, drink with `/drink`. Gather bits in yer `/satchel` (forage an' the market) first.

`/crafts` is yer gear book — crafted recipes with 🟢/🔴 dots *and* an Earned section for perk pieces (Magpie's Eye = befriend all five Nifflers, an' so on). Cosmetic bits ye `/craft` from yer satchel; earned gear unlocks when ye hit the goal. `/jewelbox` shows what ye own, ready crafts, an' locked earned goals; `/wear` an' `/remove` kit ye out. `/title` picks which earned title shows under yer name.

Five houses chase one Cup — Thornmere, AsterWilde (once Moonveil), Veyren, Caldrin, Oakmont (once Vashara). Almost everythin' ye do earns points for yer house. `/standings` shows the table; `/points` shows yer own; `/profile` is the full picture.
Challenges post for everyone — first three correct answers win points. Daily, Trial, an' Rite all ping @everyone when they go up. `/challengestatus` shows what's open.

Wizard's Chess an' Wizard's Checkers share the board-games channel — `/chess challenge` or `/checkers challenge`. Accept, then tap Make move (piece → square). Checkers jumps are mandatory; keep jumpin' with the same piece. Wins pay house points (chess 3, checkers 1), capped per day.
`/bean` spends 1 point on a mystery bean. Might pay 5. Might be Mordy's socks. Aye, really.
`/rumor` conjures a whisper from the mill — explore secrets, student gossip, odd headmaster talk, embarrassín' ghosts. Believe nothin'.
The founders never quite left. Their stories live on the Compendium Ghosts page — an' sometimes in a `/rumor` if the mill's feelin' cheeky.
Tap `/help` for everythin' the bot can do, grouped an' clickable. Or browse Every Command on the Compendium if ye want the big map.
`/profile` is yer whole sheet — Mirror, wand, points, ranks, beasts. `/standings` is the Cup table; `/leaderboard` the top earners; `/duelrecord` yer duel sheet.

Staff tools split across four roots (Discord size cap): `/staff` (points, setup, houses, identity, usage, sync), `/staffgame` (descent, castles, raid, duels, challenge, hex, market), `/staffworld` (world, dementor), `/staffops` (beasts, gear admin, reaction roles, antispam). `/staff usage top` an' `/staff usage unused` show what the server uses. Player verbs (`/wand`, `/duel`, `/broom`…) never moved. Full list in `/help`.
